note: SHIPPED ON THE CANONICAL-SUBSTITUTE ROUTE, NOT BLOCKED -- batch_545 predicted this table would block on the same ground as chen_2022_cesd; it does not, and the difference is recorded here. LICENCE: same deposit as chen_2022_cesd, and it is CC BY-NC 4.0: the re-fetched DOI landing page's schema.org JSON-LD reads "license":"https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/" beside a description naming the 'Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale (GAD-7)' and the one .sav (md5 0a98b6eec92b1409e0e0f36cd60d3775); the processing script header also says 'Original license: CC BY-NC 4.0'. So NOTHING in this table's wording is copied from the deposit: the depositors' English labels (e.g. GAD01 'In the past two weeks, how often have I felt nervous, anxious or anxious in my life?', value labels never/several days/more than 1 week/almost every day) are not shipped. WHY IT SHIPS: itemtext_standard.md (ECR-R ruling) -- 'the licence of the source IRW actually copied from governs'; the wording is copied from the rights holder's own GAD-7_English.pdf, whose footer reads 'No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.' and whose select-screener page reads 'All PHQ, GAD-7 screeners and translations are downloadable from this website and no permission is required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute them' (both re-fetched and quoted 2026-09-27). instrument_rights_register.csv already carries verdict=ship for the PHQ/GAD family on that express grant; applied, not re-derived, and no register row written. The NC deposit is used only to tie code to item, the hannachi_2025_eco_anxiety_cas (batch_292) shape. Per the li_2024_bdyz ruling the substitute must be a straight translation with a checkable mapping: the seven .sav labels correspond one-to-one and in order to canonical GAD-7 items 1-7 (nervous/anxious; unable to stop or control worrying; worried too much about various things; difficult to relax; unable to sit still; easily upset or impatient; feel as if something terrible will happen and be afraid) -- 7/7, no divergence. This is exactly where chen_2022_cesd differed: its CESD02 label is a self-harm item, not canonical CES-D-10 item 2, so the canonical route could not rescue it. MAPPING: mapping_basis=data_labels -- the IRW item codes ARE the .sav column names (script selects paste0('GAD', sprintf('%02d',1:7)) by name, no rename), and each column's own variable label names its item; exempt from Step 5b by derivation (pattern 1). LANGUAGE: administered in Chinese (77,211 Chinese college students; the .sav's only CJK text is the region value labels, and the GAD01-GAD07 variable and value labels contain zero CJK characters), so the administered wording is not recoverable from the deposit (no paper, no supplement). Fallback: canonical English in the base fields, language=Chinese, no _translated columns, text_source=translated_substitute, translation_source=official_instrument_english. The administered Chinese anchor 2 evidently read as 'more than one week' (depositors' rendering), a common Chinese GAD-7 variant; the shipped canonical 'More than half the days' is the same interval over the two-week window. Paper-form line '(Use “✔” to indicate your answer)' omitted from instructions, as in rosetti_2023_gad7. Option rows 0-3 for every item, matching the canonical 0-3 scoring and the .sav value labels' 0-3 codes. DATA CHECKS: validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (7 items, resp 0-3). Live table (irw_fetch, served from the local irw cache populated by table_context.R; 540,477 rows, 77,211 ids) equals the .sav's value counts cell for cell, 28/28 (e.g. GAD01 48225/24457/2726/1803). The .sav's 'Anxiety' ('Total score of GAD-7') equals the raw 7-item sum for 100% of rows. DATA FINDING: GAD03 has ZERO responses at 3 ('almost every day') among 77,211 respondents (60339/15082/1790/0), while every other item has 843-1929 at 3; GAD03 is also the lowest-mean item (0.242 vs 0.269-0.457), unusual for 'worrying too much', which is typically among the most-endorsed GAD-7 items. Present in the source .sav, not introduced by IRW processing -- probably a collection or coding defect in the source (level 3 collapsed or lost), unresolvable from the deposit. The shipped option row GAD03/resp 3 is the instrument's, not evidence it was used. FLAGS (not acted on): the response table itself comes from a CC BY-NC 4.0 deposit, which datastandard.md bars at intake (raised in batch_545 for all three chen_2022_* tables); sibling chen_2022_sasc shipped the deposit's own labels pre-ruling (irw#1954 re-audit candidate).
public_note: Item and response-option wording is the standard English GAD-7 (Spitzer et al. 2006) as distributed on phqscreeners.com, standing in for the Chinese version respondents actually read, which the source deposit does not include; in the source data item GAD03 has no responses at all in its top category ('Nearly every day', 0 of 77,211), which likely reflects a collection or coding problem in the original data.
